beats.label: S1 · The secret couple
beats.text: Monsé returns from writing camp to Freeridge and confronts Cesar over their hidden summer fling; they agree to keep dating in secret from Ruby and Jamal.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Monsé–Cesar relationship is the emotional spine the whole season pivots on.

beats.label: S1 · Oscar pulls Cesar in
beats.text: Cesar's older brother Oscar, freshly out of prison, forces him to run errands for the Santos, dragging Cesar into gang life the friends spend the season trying to reverse.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Oscar as the gravitational force on Cesar and the Santos as the threat driving the plot.

beats.label: S1 · Olivia joins the group
beats.text: Olivia, a family friend, moves in with Ruby's household and slots into the crew; Ruby falls hard for her while she quietly gravitates toward Cesar.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the love triangle whose collision at the finale reshapes every friendship.

beats.label: S1 · The kiss detonates the group
beats.text: Cesar and Olivia kiss on Halloween; when she blurts it out during a neighborhood lockdown, Ruby and Monsé stop speaking to Cesar and the friendship fractures.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The betrayal that isolates Cesar and reshuffles every alliance heading into the finale.

beats.label: S1 · Green-lit to kill
beats.text: The rival Prophet Latrelle pulls a gun on Cesar, and Oscar orders his little brother to kill Latrelle first to prove himself to the Santos.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The hit order is the ticking clock that makes the finale's shooting inevitable.

beats.label: S1 · RollerWorld hunt pays off
beats.text: Jamal's obsessive chase for the buried RollerWorld heist money leads through Chivo's nursery and a fake box of chocolate coins before he finally digs up the real cash under the football field.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The money is a live secret going into next season and only Jamal knows.

beats.label: S1 · Quinceañera shooting
beats.text: Cesar spares Latrelle, but Latrelle crashes Olivia's quinceañera and opens fire; one bullet passes through Ruby and Olivia as the ambulances arrive.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The cliffhanger event: two of the four leads are shot, one may not survive.

cliffhanger.text: Latrelle's bullet has torn through both Ruby and Olivia at her own quinceañera and vanished into the night, while Jamal stands alone over a hole full of RollerWorld cash nobody else knows exists.
questions: Do Ruby and Olivia survive the shooting?
What does Jamal do with the RollerWorld money now that he actually has it?
Will Cesar face consequences from Oscar and the Santos for letting Latrelle live?

characters.name: Monsé Finnie
characters.line: The group's tough-minded center; secretly dating Cesar, and just met the mother she thought had abandoned her.

characters.name: Cesar Diaz
characters.line: Sweet, conflicted freshman being forced into the Santos by his brother, now marked by the Prophets and estranged from his friends after the Olivia kiss.

characters.name: Ruby Martinez
characters.line: The planner of the group, hopelessly in love with Olivia; took a bullet meant for Cesar at her quinceañera.

characters.name: Jamal Turner
characters.line: The paranoid, conspiracy-minded friend who quit football and secretly unearthed the buried RollerWorld heist money at the finale.

characters.name: Olivia
characters.line: Family friend living with the Martinezes, briefly entangled with Cesar before choosing Ruby; shot at her own quinceañera.

characters.name: Oscar 'Spooky' Diaz
characters.line: Cesar's older brother and Santos shot-caller, out of prison and using Cesar as his enforcer.

characters.name: Latrelle
characters.line: Prophet gang member who pulled the trigger at the quinceañera and fled the scene.

characters.name: Abuelita Marisol
characters.line: Ruby's grandmother; the neighborhood's oracle who fed Jamal every early lead on the RollerWorld money.

characters.name: Julia
characters.line: Monsé's long-absent mother, confirmed this season while Monsé was babysitting her other children.
